credits.title: The Awakening
credits.overview: An elite military unit on a mission in the South American jungle encounters a deadly supernatural force revealing an ancient presence that continues to claim anyone who dares enter its domain.

credits.title: Los de la culpa
credits.overview: A group of comedians lose popularity in their shows; invited by a wealthy film director, they decide to attend a mysterious party that spirals out of control and ends in a murder. Are they the culprits?
